mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_organization_unit WHERE placeholder = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN parent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, parent_id ASC, order_no ASC, id ASC

WITH RECURSIVE organization_tree(id) AS ( SELECT id FROM t_organization_unit WHERE id=#{organizationUnitId} AND placeholder=0 AND enabled=1 UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM t_organization_unit child INNER JOIN organization_tree parent ON child.parent_id=parent.id WHERE child.placeholder=0 AND child.enabled=1 ) SELECT id FROM organization_tree ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_organization_unit (code, name, type, parent_id, leader_employee_id, order_no, placeholder, enabled, version, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{type}, #{parentId}, #{leaderEmployeeId}, #{orderNo}, #{placeholder}, #{enabled}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{editTime}, #{editBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_organization_unit SET name = #{organizationUnit.name}, type = #{organizationUnit.type}, parent_id = #{organizationUnit.parentId}, leader_employee_id = #{organizationUnit.leaderEmployeeId}, order_no = #{organizationUnit.orderNo}, enabled = #{organizationUnit.enabled}, version = version + 1, edit_time = #{organizationUnit.editTime}, edit_by = #{organizationUnit.editBy} WHERE id = #{organizationUnit.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND placeholder = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT assignment.employee_id) FROM t_employee_assignment assignment INNER JOIN t_employee employee ON employee.id = assignment.employee_id WHERE assignment.organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId} AND assignment.status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) AND employee.employment_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'HANDOVER')
